retrieval_method: MCCY facts extracted from web tool readable official page; NEA facts additionally checked against downloaded official FAQ PDF.

facts: NEA licensed about 2700 swimming pools at that date; approximate figure, not a hard numerical upper limit.
SportSG managed 27 ActiveSG pools at that date.
sources.admission: Historical approximate totals cannot bound 2026 public venues.

facts: Licensable categories include swimming pools, water playgrounds and multi-use spa pools.
Aquatic facilities in residential premises do not need a licence.
One or more aquatic facilities sharing recirculated water can be licensed by system.
sources.admission: No current complete licensing-count table obtained; licence count cannot automatically be treated as venue count.
